name: Dawning Wood Catacombs
summary: Undead fill the Dawning Wood Catacombs beneath Raven Hill Cemetery in western Duskwood. Their stone tunnels hold skeletal guards and ravenous ghouls.

sections.title: Beneath Raven Hill
sections.body: The Dawning Wood Catacombs lie beneath the ruined Raven Hill Cemetery. Before the twilight curse came over the forest, the dead of the surrounding woods rested in these stone corridors. Now the catacombs hold some of the region’s deadliest undead, and their depths are dangerous for lone travelers. Two subterranean wings divide the catacombs. Ranks of animated skeletons guard ancestral tombs in the western passages. To the east, the tunnels descend into a foul warren overrun by ravenous, disease-bearing ghouls.

faq.q: Where are the Dawning Wood Catacombs located?
faq.answer: The catacombs lie beneath Raven Hill Cemetery, on Duskwood’s far western edge. Their entrances descend from among the sprawling grave markers and ruined crypts.

aliases: what is in dawning wood catacombs
faq.answer: The catacombs hold Duskwood’s most concentrated and ferocious undead. Heavily armed skeletal warriors defend the western wing, while savage, plague-ridden ghouls infest the eastern tunnels.

faq.q: Why were the catacombs built in the first place?
faq.answer: The catacombs were excavated as a grand burial vault for local families and luminaries, when the region was still green. The curse that later engulfed the woods reanimated those buried within.

faq.q: Is it safe to explore the catacombs alone?
faq.answer: Exploring the catacombs alone is perilous. Tight packs of aggressive undead can overwhelm isolated travelers, and the close tunnels leave little room to retreat.

angles.text: For a paladin, these catacombs hold the fallen of the kingdom, and their desecrated tombs call for the Light’s holy wrath.
For a priest, restless spirits and decaying corpses cry out beneath Raven Hill’s stone vaults for final rest. The catacombs test the faith of those who enter.
